symptom: on a 9.24 project, editing a data grid's sort rewrote its stored CustomWidgets$CustomWidgetDatabaseSource as a CustomWidgetXPathSource; an edit to a column only left it alone
cause: describe prints both source types as `database from E where …`, and the pluggable builder writes a direct-entity database source as XPath on every version, so a rebuilt widget lost the stored type
insight: Which edits rebuild what matters for reproduction: a column caption change left the grid's source untouched on main, so the bug only showed when the grid widget itself changed (its sort). Without a Studio Pro 9 sample, make the stored state with a variant build that forces the database-source path, then edit with base and fixed builds. mx check could not validate it on a fresh 9.24 app: every mxcli-written data grid 2 crashes mx 9.24 (NullReferenceException) and gallery does not build at all — the pluggable-on-9.x gap tracked in #1163; the written shape is the one #1399 measured from Studio Pro's FSM template.
